_comment: Where ops/notify-telegram.sh finds the recipient. NO chat id and NO token is stored in this repo — only paths to the file that already holds one. The Telegram bot token lives in openclaw's own store (~/.openclaw, mode 0600) and is never read by this repo. target_file_candidates is tried in order; the first that exists wins, so the same config works on Linux and on the Windows machine. AUTODEV_NOTIFY_TARGET overrides everything.
